rules: **Welcome to the Pavisie hub.** This is the home for the Pavisie Discord bot: support, updates, and a community of server owners and players.
**1. Be respectful.** No harassment, hate speech, slurs, or targeted drama.
**2. Keep it SFW.** No NSFW content, gore, or shock media anywhere.
**3. No spam or unsolicited advertising.** No invite links, self-promo, or DM advertising. Share your server in #showcase only.
**4. Use the right channel.** Support -> #support tickets. Ideas -> #suggestions / #feature-requests. Commands -> #bot-commands.
**5. No scams, phishing, or account trading.** Posting malicious links gets you removed.
**6. Follow Discord Terms of Service and Community Guidelines.**
**7. Staff decisions are logged, not hidden.** Enforcer actions land in a read-only ledger and can be appealed with /enforcer appeal.
By participating you agree to these rules. Moderators may act on anything that harms the community, listed here or not.
messages.faqSticky: **Pavisie FAQ** - Add the bot: <https://pavisie.com> | Dashboard: <https://app.pavisie.com> | Commands: <https://pavisie.com/features> | Need help? Open a ticket in #support. Use /tag <name> for quick answers.
messages.aiChatIntro: **AI chat** - @mention **Pavisie** in this channel to talk to it (it never replies unless mentioned). Keep it friendly; 30-second cooldown per person. Do not paste secrets.
messages.boosterThanks: **Thank you for boosting!** Boosters get this lounge, a custom color on request, early looks at bot updates, and priority support. Your boost keeps the hub perks unlocked.
